src/infrastructure/http/error-middleware.ts: errorMiddleware is an Express ErrorRequestHandler that only sets res.status and sends JSON error bodies. That is framework/transport work and contains no business rules.
The SyntaxError branch handles malformed JSON request bodies, which is a transport/parsing concern that belongs in the HTTP adapter.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is an Express error-handling middleware that sits in the infrastructure layer. It does only transport work: it maps application error kinds to HTTP status codes, turns malformed JSON bodies into 400 responses and returns 500 for any other error. It holds no business rules, domain decisions or persistence logic. Translating errors into HTTP responses is the job of an infrastructure/transport adapter, so the file matches the role of its declared layer.
